title: Two-Stage Cycle Surge & Slimming Playbook — predictive release lanes, role hedging, and automated micro-slim workflows
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Objective:
Deliver a repeatable, two-stage cycle orchestration playbook that lets PMs and Eng leads split large initiatives into 'mini-release lanes' (Stage A: committed lane; Stage B: surge lane) with automated signals for on-demand staff pooling and a prescriptive micro-pruning workflow.

Why this: 
- Current cycle over-commitment frequently causes last-week scope evictions that are ad-hoc and high-friction.
- We want predictable outcomes for high-impact initiatives while preserving the ability to absorb short, high-priority bursts without derailing commitments.

What success looks like (outcome metrics):
- Reduction in urgent mid-cycle scope evictions by 60% for initiatives using the playbook (12-week window).
- Time-to-staff for surge requests under the playbook <= 48 hours for 90% of requests.
- Clear audit trail of scope trims and decision rationale captured in the cycle board for all Stage B activations.

Scope:
- Create decision matrix for two-stage lane assignment and thresholds for promoting work between lanes.
- Define role-level hedging rules (which roles eligible for surge, minimum shadowing cover).
- Author the automated micro-trimming checklist and a one-click scope eviction template for cycle boards.
- Build a lightweight capacity simulator (spreadsheet + runbook) and templates for leads.
- Integrate with on-call/staffing roster process and create Slack + email templates for surge requests.

Out of scope (this ticket):
- Automated staff reallocation in payroll/HR systems.
- Changes to compensation or hiring process.

Stakeholders: 
- PM leads (primary), Eng managers, Design leads, Solutions Eng, People Ops (capacity constraints), Growth (where applicable).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Overuse of Stage B = consistent under-delivery on Stage A. Mitigation: thresholding, monthly review of Stage B activation rates, gating future activation if misuse detected.
- Risk: Perceived complexity. Mitigation: single-page cheat sheet + training drop-in for cycle leads.

Next steps (this ticket):
1) Draft decision matrix and role-hedging rulebook (owner: PM).
2) Build capacity simulator spreadsheet and example scenarios (owner: Eng PM/Analyst).
3) Draft micro-trim checklist and Slack request templates (owner: PM + Design).
4) Run two tabletop exercises with two cross-functional initiatives (owner: PM).
5) Iterate and publish the playbook in Confluence and Surface in Cycle kickoff templates.
acceptance_criteria: Published playbook page in Confluence with decision matrix and 2 worked examples
Capacity simulator spreadsheet with three scenario presets and a how-to guide
Slack + email surge request templates and a one-click board template for Stage B activation
Two tabletop exercises completed with notes, retro actions captured
Rollout training session scheduled and recorded; at least 6 leads attended
